Map TO is a STILL-STUB anchor with interior delta: $FA$_t_4d8abf lives at 0x4d8abf (dis.py site annotation verbatim, call target 0x4d8ac0 = anchor+1; delta +0x1 verified against FA rel32 e8 39440000 -> 0x4d8ac0; stub group t000da.obj covers 0x4d8abf). alias 0=$FA$_t_4d4670 defines this chunk's own anchor.

EXACT v1, plain C, no patches. void __cdecl f(long** p) { long* t; long z; t=*p; z=0; t[27]=z; t=*p; t[5]=z; } -- FA stages the zero ONCE in edx (xor edx,edx) then stores with reg moves (89 51 6c / 89 51 14); spelling both stores through a z local forces the stage-reuse instead of two c7 imm32 forms, and re-spelling t=*p a second time forces FA's double reload of [p] (mov ecx,[eax] twice) - CL does not CSE them across the reassignment. offsets in long units: 0x6c=27, 0x14=5. alias 0=$FA$_t_412d30.

EXACT v1, plain C, no patches. void __cdecl f(char* p) { char* d = *(char**)(p+0x18e); *(long*)(d+0x5a)=*(long*)(p+0x102); *(long*)(d+0x5e)=*(long*)(p+0x56); } -- dst-load-then-two-stores shape: d is loaded FIRST (edx) and reused for both stores; the two source loads (p+0x102 into ecx, p+0x56 into eax) reproduce FA's register juggling. char* arithmetic keeps all byte-offset displacements unscaled. alias 0=$FA$_t_418a00.

EXACT v4, plain C, no patches. char __stdcall f(long p) { char* h = *(char**)(p+0x3c); return *(long*)(h+p)==0x4c50; } -- two steering tells: (a) param typed long (NOT char*) so CL loads it into eax FIRST and keeps p live in eax to the end (FA: eax=p survives into ret 4; sete al only touches al); (b) the loaded pointer typed char* (h) so h+p is an UNSCALED byte add -> sib 01 = [ecx+eax*1]. With h as long* CL emits sib 84 [ecx+eax*4] (v3, 1-byte miss); with p as char* + (long)p cast CL re-allocates (mov ecx,[esp+4] + push ebx pad, v2). Compare via cmp [reg+reg],imm32 (81 3c 01 504c0000) is plain-C reachable; dis.py HIDES this cmp - found only in raw FA dump. 1-byte char return keeps CL from emitting movsx/movzx after sete al. alias 0=$FA$_t_41ea30.

EXACT v2, plain C, no patches. short __cdecl f(short s) { short t=s; short r; if (t<0) return 0; r=255; if (t>255) return r; r=t; return r; } -- the FA shape is staged-then-test, NOT the naive two-if return ladder: 255 must be STAGED INTO THE RESULT REG (r) BEFORE the >255 test (FA: mov ax,0xff; cmp cx,0xff; jg ret - the >255 arm returns the already-staged r), and the in-range path copies the full dword r=t (mov eax,ecx, no movsx). r declared AFTER t so t allocates a non-ax register (cx) - that is what makes the second compare the 5-B non-acc form 66 81 f9 ff 00 (CL's ax-resident compare spells the 4-B acc form 66 3d, v1 miss) and the first test 66 85 c9 test cx,cx. short t = s keeps the 16-bit load 66 8b 4c 24 04 and 16-bit test/jge; jge polarity comes free with t<0 first. v1 (returns 0/255/t straight from two ifs) had CL's reversed arm order; v3 (ternary) and v4 (int r) also missed the staging. alias 0=$FA$_t_456c00.
